seo_title: Find Research Grants for International Students in USA
seo_description: Research grants for international students in the USA: compare graduate-focused listings, deadlines, and award ranges, then apply on official pages.
intro: Trying to find research grants in the USA for international students usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and application steps. This filtered slice narrows that search to graduate-focused listings tied to international student status, so you can compare options that may fit academic research plans, professional goals, or subject areas such as education, engineering, health, arts, and other fields. The rows below are not all built the same: award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements can range from lighter-touch applications to entries that ask for more materials, including essays. If you want to apply in the USA and avoid wasting time on poor matches, this is a practical place to start, browse, and compare.
h1: Compare USA Research Grants for International Students
supporting: Use this list as a comparison view rather than assuming every grant works the same way. Scan each row for study level, citizenship or residency wording, field tags, and any requirement notes before you click through. Some listings may be broad enough for multiple disciplines, while others are clearly tied to areas like STEM, medicine, education, or community-focused work. Because deadline text appears across these rows and some opportunities may close relatively soon, it is smart to check timing early, open the official page, and verify the current rules before you shortlist anything for a USA application plan.
related_intro: If these results feel close but not quite right, related pages can help you widen or tighten the search by topic, study level, or applicant type. That is useful when you want to compare broader international student funding in the USA against more specific graduate, STEM, education, or medicine-focused options.

faq.question: How can I find research grants in the USA for international graduate students?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to compare rows marked for international students and graduate-level study in the USA. Then open the official source for each listing to confirm eligibility, funding details, and application steps.

faq.question: Can I apply to every program listed here as an international student?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. These listings are relevant to the search, but eligibility can still vary by program, field, residency status, and other requirements shown on the official page.

faq.question: Do all USA research grants on this page have the same deadline or award amount?
faq.answer: No—deadlines differ by program, and award amounts vary by listing. Check each row carefully and verify the current amount and deadline on the official source before you apply.

faq.question: What kinds of topics can I explore in these listings?
faq.answer: This focused set of listings includes programs connected with areas such as Education, STEM, Medicine, Arts, Community, and Miscellaneous topics. If you are trying to find a closer match, compare category labels and fields of study before applying.
